description.p: Rahasyakosh keeps your logins and two-factor codes in an encrypted vault on your own computer. There are no accounts, no telemetry and no network access.
Each person sharing the computer can have a profile with their own vault and master password. Passwords can be imported from browsers and other password managers, and exported again.
Early alpha. It has not been independently audited, so do not store real secrets in it yet.

description.p: First public alpha. Includes profiles, import from Bitwarden / KeePassXC / 1Password, export, two-factor codes, and full screen-reader support. Not independently audited — do not store real secrets.
